title: Event Data
description: Event Data includes results for each simulated conformance event, organized by event number and model type: RAS, HMS, ResSim, and system response. Hydraulic results are organized by model unit. model-unit.p01.hdf includes event conditions, geometry, plan data, and results; model-unit.p01.tmp.hdf provides input data required for cloud simulation. ras-event-summary.json summarizes 2D-area cumulative net precipitation and volume accounting error, boundary condition lines, breaching status, reference-line peak flows, water surface elevations (WSEL), velocities, structure variable peaks, computation time, core count, run time window, solution status, and instability information. rasoutput.log records the RAS version, progress, iteration status, volume accounting and water surface elevation errors, and other warnings or errors. Hydrologic outputs include SST.dss time-series and paired HMS data, exported-precip.dss gridded precipitation, and exported-precip.tmp.hdf gridded precipitation required for cloud compute. exported-precip.dss is optional, generated by request to the Cloud Compute Lead, and required to reproduce a cloud-simulated event on desktop. Reservoir-operations outputs include 1h_peaks.csv, 24h_peaks.csv, 48h_peaks.csv, and 72h_peaks.csv summarizing ResSim element peaks, ffrd.simperiod matching the ResSim time window to HMS for seasonal pool operations, and simulation.dss time-series and paired ResSim output. System-response failure_elevations.json records sampled failure or breach elevations, with location identifiers such as NID or NLD and the failure_elevation triggering a breach.
